limits: This register specifies missing evidence, not completed verification. Source corrections, passing offline checks and closed workstream issues do not establish runtime, cost, incident or legal acceptance.

required_evidence: Dated region, instance type, purchase option and quoted or billed hourly rate for the stated GRPO workload.
Measured training duration, GPU count and utilization for that same workload.
Reproducible cost arithmetic tying those inputs to the claimed $2,000-$4,000 or $15,000 figures.
Matched workload traces, billed node hours and utilization for the cascade and non-cascade deployments.
Scaling schedule, idle or warm-standby capacity and cold-start behavior for both deployments.
A cost calculation that includes those deployment costs before treating the hypothetical 66% saving or 0.30 multiplier as measured.
An authoritative, versioned resolution of the conflicting EC2 and Neuron Trainium2 memory or bandwidth specifications.
The exact instance and chip scope, units, retrieval date and primary source for each number retained.
Matching Korean and English specification text after that conflict is resolved.
The original Auto Mode and Managed Node Group scheduling-stall incident logs and relevant NodePool, node and Pod configuration.
Pinned EKS, Karpenter and add-on versions, workload conditions and a reproducible failure or an authoritative compatibility finding.
Evidence identifying the stall cause rather than inferring it from coexisting node-management modes.
Time-aligned ALB access logs identifying the reported 503 origin and target-state history.
Karpenter consolidation events, workload readiness and termination events for the same interval.
A causal account distinguishing ALB fail-open behavior from the specific incident's 503 cause.
Official model IDs, supported API and dated regional availability for both GLM 4.7 and Solar Pro 3 on Amazon Bedrock.
The target account's authorized model access or an operator-provided availability check without copied credentials.
Documented model-selection configuration matching those exact IDs and APIs; no paid inference is required merely to record the gap.
The specific current Korean Electronic Financial Supervision Regulation, ISMS-P and PIPA clauses relevant to each retained residency claim.
The data category, regulated entity, cross-border-transfer mechanism and scope to which each clause applies.
A qualified domain or legal review of that applicability; GDPR Chapter V alone cannot establish the Korean claims.
Original pipeline-parallel loading incident logs, model, hardware and pinned vLLM, SGLang and dependency versions.
A bounded reproduction distinguishing slow loading from an actual deadlock.
Comparable evidence for the stated SGLang behavior under the same conditions.
Original workload, protocol, network path, sample size and latency percentiles for the comparison.
Dated AWS region, direction, service, purchase tier and primary transfer-price references.
Evidence connecting the stated latency and transfer-price cells to those conditions before restoring unscoped numbers.
Pinned versions and setup for every compared AI coding agent.
Primary feature documentation and repeatable checks for the compared behaviors.
An explicit rating rule and observed results before replacing the Full, Partial and Limited author estimates with verified ratings.
An operator-selected, pinned NVIDIA Network Operator chart and CRD version with documented host, NIC and Kubernetes prerequisites.
Matching NicClusterPolicy, SriovNetworkNodePolicy, NetworkAttachmentDefinition and workload resources for that version.
Reconciliation results, VF ownership and a successful workload attachment before treating the current starting-point values as validated.
